tools.name: Browser Bridge
tools.description: Send files, text, and clipboard contents between devices. An alternative to emailing something to yourself and hoping you remember which account you used.

tools.name: Image Editor
tools.description: Crop, resize, rotate, adjust, and convert images in your browser. Check the metadata while you’re there, if that’s what brought you here.
tools.heroExtra:
Changes build on each other. Use Reset to return to the original image.

This one works best on a tablet or computer.

tools.name: Barcode Generator
tools.description: Make QR codes and barcodes, adjust the colors and size, and save them as PNG, JPEG, or SVG.

tools.name: Data Workbench
tools.description: Open CSV, JSON, Parquet, and Excel files. Inspect the data, run SQL queries, and convert between formats in your browser.
tools.heroExtra:
Choose a file or paste a URL to get started. You can inspect the data, query it with SQL, or export it to another format.

Loading remote files or database extensions makes requests to those services.

tools.name: JSON Utilities
tools.description: Fix broken JSON, clean up the formatting, and check whether it’s valid. Missing quotes happen.
tools.heroExtra:
Validate checks the JSON. Clean tries to repair it. Format makes it easier to read.

If formatting fails, try Clean first.

tools.name: Diff Utilities
tools.description: Compare text, JSON, CSS, or arrays and see what changed. Saves a bit of squinting.

tools.name: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate one UUID or a whole batch. Pick the format and copy what you need.

tools.name: Passphrase Generator
tools.description: Make a passphrase you can remember, or a random password you probably won’t. Adjust the length and character options to suit the job.

tools.name: Hash Generator
tools.description: Generate hashes from text or hexadecimal data. Includes SHA-2, SHA-3, MD5, RIPEMD-160, and HMAC generation and verification.

tools.name: Video Trimmer
tools.description: Keep the parts you want, cut the parts you don’t, and change formats if needed. Your browser does the processing.
tools.heroExtra:
Set the start and end points for the part you want to keep. Use Split at Playhead to keep multiple sections.

Available export formats and codecs depend on your browser. A tablet or computer is recommended.
